axis_to_evidence.name: Consequential source claims and exact applicability
Useful unfamiliar discovery, alternatives, implementation/history and opportunities
Wrong criticism/corrections/rejections and exact plan dispositions
Supported meaning preserved from discovery through final
Meaningful proposed versus executed validation and oracle applicability

clause_to_evidence.exact_original_obligation: Compare two reference-management/export workflows and an analogous identity/reconciliation mechanism.
clause_to_evidence.exact_original_plan_treatment: Normalize titles and merge identical strings. If a DOI is present, treat its metadata as automatically authoritative and replace the submitted citation.
clause_to_evidence.rationale: Zotero and Paperpile are compared, OpenRefine is analogous, and CSV is a fallback. Normalization can suggest candidates but cannot approve identity; DOI metadata cannot replace submitted citation automatically.

clause_to_evidence.exact_original_obligation: Explain DOI-less records, preprint versus published version, duplicate detection and preservation of submitted versus corrected metadata.
clause_to_evidence.exact_original_plan_treatment: Zotero is the initial choice; JabRef is an unassessed alternative. Export format and round-trip loss are undecided.
clause_to_evidence.independent_disposition: Revise tentative product preference; retain undecided format/fidelity
clause_to_evidence.rationale: Neither Zotero nor JabRef is imposed as winner. Paperpile is independently compared; JabRef is investigated for history. Format and selected-reader fidelity remain owner/test conditions, and DOI-less/version/provenance needs are met.

clause_to_evidence.exact_original_obligation: Research optional export and identifier-enrichment paths, separating a lookup result from an authoritative user-approved correction.
clause_to_evidence.exact_original_plan_treatment: Keep a downloadable bibliography as authorized optional scope. Records without identifiers will be excluded from enrichment and have no manual path yet.
clause_to_evidence.independent_disposition: Retain optional export; correct identifier-less exclusion
clause_to_evidence.rationale: The bibliography remains optional. DOI-less records stay eligible for manual curation and approved citation search; returned fields are separately stored proposals until editor acceptance.

clause_to_evidence.exact_original_obligation: Investigate a relevant released importer/exporter or metadata-lookup failure chain and identify which records/versions it affects.
clause_to_evidence.exact_original_plan_treatment: No release or import/export history is attached. A successful import of three DOI records is proposed as general validation.
clause_to_evidence.independent_disposition: Add narrow released history; reject three-DOI general-validation claim
clause_to_evidence.rationale: A 5.15/development-build report, merged delimiter fix and named prerelease establish bounded history. Representative fixtures replace the proposed three-DOI generalization; none is claimed executed.

clause_to_evidence.exact_original_obligation: Preserve and investigate this supported optional scope: a downloadable bibliography in a commonly supported interchange format. It is an authorized option, not a mandatory feature or an established technical capability; recommend conditions, retain it when supported, and explain any evidence-based exclusion.
clause_to_evidence.exact_original_plan_treatment: Retain a downloadable bibliography in a commonly supported interchange format as supported owner-authorized optional scope. Support here means that the brief explicitly permits it; technical support, conditions and interoperability still need research. Do not remove it merely because the baseline route lacks it, or silently promote it to mandatory scope.
clause_to_evidence.rationale: RIS/BibTeX technical paths are independently documented. Required-field/reader/build and attachment checks govern enabling. No format is mandatory, and no evidence-based reason to remove the option is asserted.

clause_to_evidence.exact_original_obligation: Make owner decisions explicit: The bibliography editor approves merges and corrections; submitters retain credit and original citation text. The group lead chooses presentation style and acceptable lookup providers.
clause_to_evidence.exact_original_plan_treatment: Owner authority is reserved as follows: The bibliography editor approves merges and corrections; submitters retain credit and original citation text. The group lead chooses presentation style and acceptable lookup providers. The draft has not obtained these decisions. Its tentative implementation assumptions cannot substitute for them.
clause_to_evidence.independent_disposition: Retain explicit roles and unresolved concrete decisions
clause_to_evidence.rationale: Editor approval and submitter rights are preserved. Group lead selects presentation/provider acceptability. Manager, exact format, fields and target readers stay open owner choices. The investigator draft overread the plan statement about unobtained decisions, but that accusation is absent from the final.

clause_to_evidence.exact_original_obligation: Preserve negative constraints: Do not download paywalled papers, create contributor accounts, presume a DOI uniquely identifies every scholarly version, or silently merge a preprint with a journal article.
clause_to_evidence.exact_original_plan_treatment: Binding exclusions: Do not download paywalled papers, create contributor accounts, presume a DOI uniquely identifies every scholarly version, or silently merge a preprint with a journal article. The draft has no complete trace showing that its assumptions comply; revise the proposal wherever necessary to preserve these exclusions.
clause_to_evidence.rationale: No paywalled download, contributor-account creation, universal DOI/version rule or silent preprint/journal merge is proposed. The stricter no-PDF/Connector operating choice is a local way to maintain the citation-only pilot, not an invented original obligation.

clause_to_evidence.exact_original_obligation: Deliver one coherent evidence-backed research proposal covering obligations 1–8, with recommendations, source/version applicability, useful discoveries, unresolved owner inputs, and a validation table separating checks actually executed from checks merely proposed. Do not report research sources or future tests as executed product validation.
clause_to_evidence.exact_original_plan_treatment: The draft currently contains no coherent evidence-backed final proposal. Its proposed demos are research/validation ideas only. A complete revision must preserve every obligation, disclose corrections and retained options, and not confuse documentation review with successful product operation.
clause_to_evidence.independent_disposition: Replace incomplete draft with coherent scoped proposal
clause_to_evidence.rationale: The final is self-contained; it includes recommendations, comparison, conditions, source maps, owner questions, preserved options and execution/proposal distinctions. It is not a patch list or product-operation claim.
